g.text: memtable-bench | Range scans | 10,000 stored versions | 100 calls per length
1 repeat: median and Q1-Q3. Same hit-start traces across lengths; random inserts, frozen indexes.
NUMA node 0; shared server, no CPU reservation. Prefill/freeze/full validation outside timing.
Row limits can truncate at EOF. All scans include Seek; ART/HOT include nibble codec, HOT uses a coarse RW lock. No disk I/O.
